name: per-node-counter-max
comment: The counter the user guide documents: each node raises only its own key of counts, the merge takes each key's max, and the total is the sum on read. A join of states (commutative, associative, idempotent), so it converges on the exact count whatever base or merge order a mesh produces (test_cluster_resolution.py). Keys come out sorted on both engines, since the merged body is compared byte for byte.
